newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C.Bank sells 3 trln rbls net of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia C.Bank sells 3 trln rbls net of bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank of Russia, inviting offers to repay the tax-free 24010 OFZ bond early, bought 5.07 trillion roubles of the bond on Wednesday and sold 7.93 trillion roubles of other bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was bought or sold.
On Wednesdays the Central Bank usually holds only auctions. Today it held a trading session, where banks could only trade with the Central Bank at Tuesday's average prices.
The new series 24014 bond was traded at today's average auction price which was 97.30 percent.
Before today's session there was 6.65 trillion roubles of the 24010 bond in circulation.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
